properties.description: Identifies alerts raised by Varonis threat detection policies and creates a Microsoft Sentinel alert for each one, with severity and MITRE ATT&CK tactic taken from the Varonis alert.
properties.query:
VaronisAlertsV2_CL
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by AlertId_g
| extend MappedSeverity = case(
    AlertSeverity_s in~ ("Critical", "High"), "High",
    AlertSeverity_s =~ "Medium", "Medium",
    AlertSeverity_s =~ "Low", "Low",
    AlertSeverity_s =~ "Informational", "Informational",
    "Medium")
| extend MitreTactic = replace_string(replace_string(MitreTacticName_s, " and ", " And "), " ", "")
| extend AccountName = trim(@"\s+", extract(@"^[^,;]+", 0, UserSamAccountNames_s))
| extend HostName = trim(@"\s+", extract(@"^[^,;]+", 0, DeviceNames_s))
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    AlertId_g,
    ThreatDetectionPolicyName_s,
    MappedSeverity,
    AlertSeverity_s,
    MitreTactic,
    AlertCategory_s,
    Status_s,
    AccountName,
    HostName,
    UserSamAccountNames_s,
    DeviceNames_s,
    Assets_s,
    EventsCount_d,
    PrivilegedAccountType_s,
    SensitiveDataExposed_s,
    FlaggedDataExposed_s,
    ContainsMaliciousExternalIPs_b,
    AbnormalLocations_s,
    InitialEventTimeUTC_t

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: Varonis threat detection policy {{ThreatDetectionPolicyName_s}} raised this alert with a Varonis severity of {{AlertSeverity_s}} in the category {{AlertCategory_s}}. Review the custom details for the accounts, devices, assets and data involved, then investigate the alert in Varonis.
